Tidiva support

How do I change or cancel Premium?

Open Settings → Subscription in Tidiva and choose Change or cancel subscription. Apple handles billing. To recover an eligible purchase, use Restore purchases with the Apple Account that made it.

How do I remove calendar events?

Open Calendar in Tidiva, choose Remove Tidiva events, and confirm. Your tasks stay in Tidiva. To change calendar permissions, use your iPhone settings.

How do I change reminders or erase my data?

In Settings → Daily reminders, change the times or turn reminders off. To start fresh, open Settings → Data and privacy → Reset Tidiva. Remove exported calendar events first if you also want them erased. Manage any paid subscription separately through Apple.
